study: One-shot held-out check of today's most consistent cell: does S6 (liquidity sweep -> displacement -> fair-value-gap retrace) at the 3-minute hold beat both controls on 60 sessions nobody has looked at?
registered_at: 2026-10-21 ~17:30 ET, before any held-out outcome is read
origin: Operator 10/21: 'is it possible to have the top performing Half A combined the top performing Half B'. Combining each half's own leader stacks two lucky draws (winner's curse); the honest version picks one cell by a fixed rule on all of today's discovery data and tests it once on untouched data.
selection_rule: Across every cell scored today on the warehouse with both halves graded - indicator_confirm_hist (10-minute: H1-H5, S3-S7) and three_minute_reread (3-minute: PRE, SQ, MID, BOTHUP, OSL, IGN, RSI2T, CON, S3-S7, H1-H5), 28 cells - take the four discovery reads (half A and B, same-name control d and cross control x; lift for entries, DiD for filters) and pick the cell with the HIGHEST MINIMUM of the four (the most consistent, not the largest). Applied mechanically from the committed raw result tables: 3-minute S6, reads +0.3 / +0.1 (A d / x) and +0.1 / +0.2 bp (B d / x), minimum +0.1 bp. Runner-up: 10-minute S6 (minimum +0.0). Only the winner is tested.
honest_expectation: Discovery lift is +0.1 to +0.3 bp and discovery net is about -4.8 bp per trade at the required 5 bp cost (-2.8 at 3 bp). The statistical bar below can at most confirm a sub-1-bp effect; the economic bar (net > 0) is expected to fail. The test is recorded so 'best of the day' is answered on clean data rather than argued.
data: the held-out sample ai_reports/warehouse_confirm/ on the mini: 70 sessions 2026-01-14 .. 2026-04-24 (60 scored + 10 look-back), fetched 10/21 and checked complete by three_minute_reread.check_confirm_sample; never read by any outcome. This test SPENDS it for S6 at 3 minutes; any later use is no longer held-out for this cell and is noted as reuse for others.
method: three_minute_reread's code unchanged (module shas recorded), TMR_SAMPLE=confirm: S6 exactly as structure_pullback with the history adaptation, on every name with 10 prior SIP sessions; decision minute = setup bar end; entry at the SIP open of that minute, exit at the close two minutes later; d = same-name later control (seed 'three-min-v1'), x = cross-name same minute (seed 'three-min-cross'); 5 bp required cost. All 60 sessions pooled (one test, no halves needed), day-equal, day-clustered t.
pass: ALL of: pooled lift_d > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.96 (df = days - 1); pooled lift_x > 0 with t >= 1.96; name-day-equal lift_d > 0; drop-3-names and drop-3-days lift_d >= 0; >= 300 entries and >= 20 days; AND mean net3 > 0 at 5 bp. The statistical part alone (without net > 0) is reported as 'real but unpayable', not a pass.
fail: lift_d or lift_x with t <= -2, or the 97.5% upper bound of lift_d below +5 bp: closed. Anything else: UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: the runner-up (10-minute S6) is NOT run
net at 3 and 10 bp, lag-1 entry, MFE / MAE
no_retuning: the selection rule, the chosen cell, the hold, the cost, the controls, the seeds and the sample are fixed; no other cell may be tested on this sample under this prereg.
script: a --oneshot mode for three_minute_reread.py (to be written): run the confirm path on the held-out sample for S6 only, ignoring the discovery-PASS requirement, which this prereg replaces for this one cell.
